CustomField.description: Determines the Lead locale based on Country field. Returns en_US for US-based leads, defaults to en_GB for all others including blank values.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( LOWER(TRIM(Country)) = "united states", LOWER(TRIM(Country)) = "usa", LOWER(TRIM(Country)) = "us" ), "en_US", IF( OR( ISBLANK(Country), LOWER(TRIM(Country)) = "united kingdom", LOWER(TRIM(Country)) = "uk", LOWER(TRIM(Country)) = "great britain" ), "en_GB", "en_GB" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Locale derived from Lead Country. US variants return en_US; all other countries default to en_GB.
CustomField.label: Lead Locale
